newsitem.title: USA: Apple general counsel Stead resigns.
newsitem.headline: Apple general counsel Stead resigns.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said Edward Stead, senior vice president and general counsel, has decided to resign to pursue other interests.
His resignation will is effective September 11.
It said Paul Carmichael, Apple's director of Patent and Trademark Operations, will serve as acting general counsel until a successor is named.

Stead, who joined Apple in 1988, also served as Secretary of the Corporation since September 1993. Until a replacement is appointed, George Scalise, executive vice president and chief administrative officer, will assume that role.
